docs.title: About essdive-linkml-schemas
docs.text:
This project contains the reviewed ESS-DIVE Dataset metadata model. Its project scaffolding was migrated from linkmltest; conversion tooling now lives separately in essdive-admin/essdive_schema_converter.

The migration used the final dist/essdive_metadata_schema.yaml output from the converter, including the approved Northwest and Southeast descriptions. The source schema was copied without changes. Its SHA-256 at migration was fbd8ebbba190947f7aa559dcb0670e5c8e8816390247e141d6e3a64cd9dfbe69.

The LinkML schema records source provenance and modeling decisions in a one-way conversion from OpenAPI. It is a curated metadata model; consult the OpenAPI source for exact API validation behavior.

docs.text: Main JSON-LD data model for an ESS-DIVE Dataset. Use this dataset for creating and updating datasets

docs.title: Induced
docs.text:
name: Dataset
description: Main JSON-LD data model for an ESS-DIVE Dataset.  Use this dataset for
  creating and updating datasets
from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
slot_usage:
  type:
    name: type
    ifabsent: string(Dataset)
    alias: '@type'
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,}(?![\s\S])
    all_of:
    - pattern: Dataset
  name:
    name: name
    description: (Title) A brief but meaningful title for this data package.
    range: string
    required: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,512}(?![\s\S])
  description:
    name: description
    description: (Abstract) A concise description of the purpose and content of this
      data package.
    required: true
attributes:
  id:
    name: id
    description: The public identifier of this dataset; typically a DOI (Digital Object
      Identifier)
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    alias: '@id'
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    - Organization
    - OrganizationMember
    - Person
    - DatasetProvider
    range: string
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,2048}(?![\s\S])
    all_of:
    - pattern: ^(?!^ess-dive-)
  datePublished:
    name: datePublished
    description: '(Publication Date) Specify a custom date or year when this data
      package can be made publicly available. If this is not specified, it will default
      to the current date.

      The value should either by a four digit year (YYYY) or a full date in the ISO
      format (YYYY-MM-DD).'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:datePublished
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    required: true
    pattern: ^([012]\d{3}(-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?)$
  context:
    name: context
    description: JSON-LD context used to interpret the document’s terms.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    ifabsent: string(http://schema.org/)
    alias: '@context'
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    pattern: http://schema.org/
  alternateName:
    name: alternateName
    description: (Alternative Identifiers) DOI and alternate identifiers of the data
      package if it has been previously published elsewhere. Alternate identifers
      provide pertinent information that can identify and locate the data set within
      your site's data management system.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:alternateName
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,2048}(?![\s\S])
  creator:
    name: creator
    description: (Creator/Author) The main researchers involved in producing the data.
      These include authors, owners, originators and principal investigators who should
      be listed in the citation. One or more creators is required. If none are entered,
      you will be set as the creator of this document. List creators in the order
      they need to appear in the citation. More entries will appear as you enter information.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:creator
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: Person
    required: true
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    minimum_cardinality: 1
  keywords:
    name: keywords
    description: Keywords that should be associated with this data package to enable
      thematic searches.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:keywords
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,175}(?![\s\S])
    minimum_cardinality: 1
  variableMeasured:
    name: variableMeasured
    description: (Data Variables) Measurement variables present in the data package.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:variableMeasured
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,175}(?![\s\S])
    minimum_cardinality: 1
  license:
    name: license
    description: (Data Usage Rights) Choose how you wish your data to be shared and
      reused. Usage rights for the metadata will always be Creative Commons Public
      Domain.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:license
    ifabsent: string(http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0)
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    pattern: http[s]?://creativecommons.org/(licenses/by/4.0|publicdomain/zero/1.0)[/]?
  spatialCoverage:
    name: spatialCoverage
    description: (Location) Add one or more places with at least one GeoCoordinate
      and no more than two.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:spatialCoverage
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: Place
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
    minimum_cardinality: 1
  award:
    name: award
    description: (DOE Contracts) If applicable, list the numbers of any DOE contract
      under which the data in the package was funded. If the data were a result of
      a joint effort between two or more DOE Site/Facility Management Contractors,
      etc., additional DOE contract numbers may be entered.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:award
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,255}(?![\s\S])
    minimum_cardinality: 1
  funder:
    name: funder
    description: (Funding Organizations) List of organizations that funded the work.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:funder
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: Organization
    required: true
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  citation:
    name: citation
    description: (Related References) Associated publications or data packages where
      users can learn more about the dataset, processing method, or how the data were
      used.Enter the DOIs of all related papers or data packages. If no DOI is available,
      enter the current citation information for the reference.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:citation
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,1024}(?![\s\S])
  editor:
    name: editor
    description: (Contact Person) Person who should be listed as the contact for the
      data package for the purposes of the DOI or for users seeking further information
      for the data. Only one contact is allowed per data package.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:editor
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: ContactPerson
    required: true
    inlined: true
  provider:
    name: provider
    description: (Project/Publisher Identifier) Enter the identifier of the DOE project
      to associate with this dataset. The project is cited as the publisher of this
      dataset. If multiple projects were involved, this is the project that had the
      largest contribution to this dataset.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:provider
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: DatasetProvider
    required: true
    inlined: true
  contributor:
    name: contributor
    description: (Contributor) Additional contributors involved in producing the data.
      These could include people who assisted in creating the data package but wouldn't
      be considered authors for publication.  Enter as many contributors as needed.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:contributor
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: Person
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true
  temporalCoverage:
    name: temporalCoverage
    description: (Start Date/End Date) The date range that the data in this data package
      covers.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:temporalCoverage
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: TemporalCoverage
    inlined: true
  measurementTechnique:
    name: measurementTechnique
    description: (Methods) Information about the methods employed in collecting or
      generating a data set or other resource. These include descriptions of sampling
      or experimental procedures, data QA/QC, processing and synthesis.  Each method
      section documents the series of procedures followed to produce data. Enter as
      many sections as needed. If you have already published the procedures used,

    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:measurementTechnique
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:
    - Dataset
    range: string
    multivalued: true
    pattern: ^[\s\S]{1,5000}(?![\s\S])
  hasPart:
    name: hasPart
    description: One or more files that are part of this data package reside outside
      of the main archive. This could be a link to an individual file or a directory.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/ess-dive/dataset/combined
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: schema:hasPart
    list_elements_unique: true
    owner: Dataset
    domain_of:

    range: WebPage
    multivalued: true
    inlined: true
    inlined_as_list: true

docs.title: Slot: affiliation
docs.text: The affiliation of a person.

docs.title: Slot: alternateName
docs.text: (Alternative Identifiers) DOI and alternate identifiers of the data package if it has been previously published elsewhere. Alternate identifers provide pertinent information that can identify and locate the data set within your site's data management system.

docs.title: Slot: archivedAt
docs.text: This respresents where a copy of this dataset resides.

docs.title: Slot: award
docs.text: (DOE Contracts) If applicable, list the numbers of any DOE contract under which the data in the package was funded. If the data were a result of a joint effort between two or more DOE Site/Facility Management Contractors, etc., additional DOE contract numbers may be entered.

docs.title: Slot: citation
docs.text: (Related References) Associated publications or data packages where users can learn more about the dataset, processing method, or how the data were used.Enter the DOIs of all related papers or data packages. If no DOI is available, enter the current citation information for the reference.

docs.title: Slot: context
docs.text: JSON-LD context used to interpret the document’s terms.

docs.title: Slot: contributor
docs.text: (Contributor) Additional contributors involved in producing the data. These could include people who assisted in creating the data package but wouldn't be considered authors for publication. Enter as many contributors as needed.

docs.title: Slot: creator
docs.text: (Creator/Author) The main researchers involved in producing the data. These include authors, owners, originators and principal investigators who should be listed in the citation. One or more creators is required. If none are entered, you will be set as the creator of this document. List creators in the order they need to appear in the citation. More entries will appear as you enter information.

docs.title: Slot: datePublished
docs.text:
(Publication Date) Specify a custom date or year when this data package can be made publicly available. If this is not specified, it will default to the current date.

The value should either by a four digit year (YYYY) or a full date in the ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: A textual description of the entity.

docs.title: Slot: editor
docs.text: (Contact Person) Person who should be listed as the contact for the data package for the purposes of the DOI or for users seeking further information for the data. Only one contact is allowed per data package.

docs.title: Slot: email
docs.text: An email address associated with the entity.

docs.title: Slot: endDate
docs.text: Last date in data package. Provide in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave blank if your data set is open-ended.

docs.title: ess_dive_dataset
docs.text:

docs.title: Slot: funder
docs.text: (Funding Organizations) List of organizations that funded the work.

docs.title: Slot: geo
docs.text: Accepted names are 'Northwest and Southeast.

docs.title: Slot: givenName
docs.text: The given name of a person.

docs.title: Slot: hasPart
docs.text: One or more files that are part of this data package reside outside of the main archive. This could be a link to an individual file or a directory.

docs.title: Slot: jobTitle
docs.text: The person’s job title; this schema restricts it to Principal Investigator.

docs.title: Slot: keywords
docs.text: Keywords that should be associated with this data package to enable thematic searches.

docs.title: Slot: latitude
docs.text: Latitude of the geographic coordinate, in decimal degrees.

docs.title: Slot: license
docs.text: (Data Usage Rights) Choose how you wish your data to be shared and reused. Usage rights for the metadata will always be Creative Commons Public Domain.

docs.title: Slot: longitude
docs.text: Longitude of the geographic coordinate, in decimal degrees.

docs.title: Slot: measurementTechnique
docs.text: (Methods) Information about the methods employed in collecting or generating a data set or other resource. These include descriptions of sampling or experimental procedures, data QA/QC, processing and synthesis. Each method section documents the series of procedures followed to produce data. Enter as many sections as needed. If you have already published the procedures used, properly cite the relevant publications.

docs.title: Slot: name
docs.text: A name or label for the entity.

docs.title: Slot: propertyID
docs.text: Identifies the property represented by a property-value pair.

docs.title: Slot: provider
docs.text: (Project/Publisher Identifier) Enter the identifier of the DOE project to associate with this dataset. The project is cited as the publisher of this dataset. If multiple projects were involved, this is the project that had the largest contribution to this dataset.

docs.title: Slot: sameAs
docs.text: DOI URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. Must begin with 'https://doi.org/'.

docs.title: Slot: spatialCoverage
docs.text: (Location) Add one or more places with at least one GeoCoordinate and no more than two.

docs.title: Slot: startDate
docs.text: Earliest date in data package. Provide in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)

docs.title: Slot: temporalCoverage
docs.text: (Start Date/End Date) The date range that the data in this data package covers.

docs.title: Slot: type
docs.text: The type of entity represented by this object.

docs.title: Slot: url
docs.text: URL of the web page.

docs.title: Slot: value
docs.text: The value associated with the identified property.

docs.text: (Data Variables) Measurement variables present in the data package.
